query:
-- Verificar os valores reais dos 4 abastecimentos afetados em fuel_records
SELECT 
  fr.id,
  fr.client_email,
  fr.client_name,
  fr.total_amount / 100 as valor_real_reais,
  fr.asaas_charge_id,
  fr.created_at
FROM fuel_records fr
WHERE fr.asaas_charge_id IN ('pay_dokgkl7e0qecp1y6', 'pay_74taoxixg0pvpwul')
   OR (fr.created_at >= '2026-05-19' AND fr.is_operational = 0)
ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC;
